entries.message: On Mac, you can put the address bar on top: choose Top under Address bar in Settings › Appearance, and the address field with back, forward and reload moves above the page.
On Mac, each page in Split View carries its own bar with back, forward, its address, Site Controls and pinned extensions, wherever the address bar is.
On Mac, pages slide and resize into place as they join or leave Split View instead of jumping.
On Mac, a folder's … button no longer covers the end of its name when you point at it. The name fades out beneath the button.
